create_feature_extractor: create a MistralCommonFeatureExtractor with an AudioEncoder to provide a HuggingFace-compatible audio preprocessing interface
process_audio_arrays: process audio arrays through MistralCommonFeatureExtractor and return padded tensor batches as BatchFeature
get_num_audio_tokens: calculate the number of audio tokens from a given audio length using sampling rate and frame rate
build_voxtral_processor: build a MistralCommonVoxtralProcessor combining a MistralTokenizer and MistralCommonFeatureExtractor for audio-text multimodal input
extract_audio_token_ids: extract audio special token IDs from the feature extractor's audio encoder for use in tokenization
